title: Automatic bank sync through Personal App Idea's server
summary: An AI assistant's first plan for bank sync: a bank-data service sends your transactions to Personal App Idea's server, which stores them unencrypted so it can sort them into categories, and first-time setup asks you to connect your bank. (Example project.)
bluf: An AI assistant proposes bank sync that sends your transactions to Personal App Idea's server, stored unencrypted so the server can sort them into categories, with "Connect your bank" as a step in first-time setup. It would save typing, but it sends money data off your device unencrypted, which is the one line Personal App Idea never crosses, and it makes a cloud feature the default instead of a choice. Decision needed: send it back for the opt-in, end-to-end encrypted design?

touched.reason: Transactions leave the device readable and sync is part of setup, so the welcome for cloud features (opt-in, end-to-end encrypted, manual entry stays the default) does not apply.

hard_limits_at_risk.reason: Every synced transaction would sit readable on Personal App Idea's server and with the bank-data service.

decision_needed: Send it back for the opt-in, end-to-end encrypted design?
